summary: @CharlieRoseMari I am always a fan of the weird, just pointing out that often the Gonzos go Bonzo over where to semantically label HTML be it in a header or a monster of a fable. Prior art, like a fart, everyone quick to assign a label.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @CharlieRoseMari I am always a fan of the weird, just pointing out that often the Gonzos go Bonzo over where to semantically label HTML be it in a header or a monster of a fable. Prior art, like a fart, everyone quick to assign a label.
